source_en: Questless Knights, Diurnus Knights, and Nocturnus Knights can enhance their weapons, indicated by a glowing effect. Counterattack them three times to remove the enhancement, or they will continue to enhance their weapons repeatedly.
new_translation_vi: Questless Knights, Diurnus Knights và Nocturnus Knights có thể cường hóa vũ khí của chúng, được biểu thị bằng hiệu ứng phát sáng. Hãy phản đòn chúng ba lần để loại bỏ trạng thái cường hóa, nếu không chúng sẽ liên tục cường hóa vũ khí của mình.

source_en: Face the Nightmare Clouds and use Utility to transform into a Lottie Lost. <color=#ffd12f>Hold the button</color> to absorb the Nightmare Clouds with her picture book!
new_translation_vi: Đối mặt với Nightmare Clouds và sử dụng Utility để biến hình thành Lottie Lost. <color=#ffd12f>Nhấn giữ nút</color> để hấp thụ Nightmare Clouds bằng cuốn sách tranh của cô ấy!

source_en:
Each of the three altars is connected to the Discipline Steles around it.
Stand on the altar platform to charge the steles, but <color=#ffd12f>Tacet Discords will appear</color> to disrupt the effort.
new_translation_vi: Mỗi bàn thờ trong số ba bàn thờ đều được kết nối với các Discipline Stele xung quanh.

source_en: In the dark area not illuminated by the Macabre Torch, Tacet Discords are enhanced, entering the Shadow state that makes them <color=#ffd12f>immune to all attacks.</color>
new_translation_vi: Trong khu vực tối không được chiếu sáng bởi Macabre Torch, các Tacet Discord sẽ được cường hóa, tiến vào trạng thái Shadow khiến chúng <color=#ffd12f>miễn nhiễm với mọi đòn tấn công.</color>

source_en:
Place the collected pieces onto the missing parts of the stained glass.
A <color=#ffd12f>golden glow</color> will appear if the piece fits correctly.
A <color=#ffd12f>red glow</color> will appear if the piece doesn't fit.
new_translation_vi: Đặt các mảnh thu thập được vào những phần còn thiếu của kính màu.

source_en:
A portable module for Synthesis integrated in <color=#ffd12f>Pangu Terminal</color>, developed by Huaxu Academy.

Can be quickly accessed via <color=#ffd12f>Item Details</color> in your Backpack.
new_translation_vi: Một mô-đun di động dùng để Tổng hợp được tích hợp trong <color=#ffd12f>Pangu Terminal</color>, do Viện Nghiên cứu Huaxu phát triển.

source_en:
[About]
As spring draws near, a group of visitors from Rinascita have visited the Jinzhou Theater. Before a brand-new stage setting, you enjoy "The Tale of Demon-Banishing Asura," a new Hero Play together. A familiar figure takes the spotlight as the Asura and performs a mesmerizing dance of blessings, offering warm wishes for the coming year with her ice-cold blade.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can invite one Companion to join you in the event every day. After the invitation, you can claim the corresponding rewards on the event page. Complete all invitations to claim Sanhua's exclusive Outfit, "Exorcistic Adjuration."

Invitation attempts reset daily at 4:00 a.m., with any unused attempts expiring at that time. Please be sure to use all your attempts promptly.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
After completing <color=#ffd12f>all Dream Patrol challenges in an area</color>, the evil thoughts buried deep in the dreamscape will materialize as Tacet Discords.

These special Tacet Discords are stronger foes. Defeat them to obtain <color=#ffd12f>special Echoes</color>.
new_translation_vi: Sau khi hoàn thành <color=#ffd12f>tất cả các thử thách Dream Patrol trong một khu vực</color>, những ý niệm xấu xa bị chôn vùi sâu trong cõi mộng sẽ hiện hình thành các Tacet Discord.

source_en:
[Event Rules]
During the event, you can use trial Resonators in special outfits to repeatedly challenge specific stages. 

The trial Resonators are at fixed levels and equipped with preselected sets of weapons and Echoes. In the trial stages, team composition and the sets of weapons and Echoes cannot be changed.

[Event Rewards]
After completing the event stages, you can claim stage rewards on the event page.
Each stage rewards can be claimed once only.
After the event concludes, rewards for cleared stages will be distributed via mail.
new_translation_vi: [Quy tắc sự kiện]

source_en:
[Outfit]
Outfits are alternative appearances for playable Resonators.

[Notes]
Some Outfits include special Weapon Projections that can change the weapon's appearance.

Some Outfits can be purchased at a special offer when on sale. Outfits on special offer revert to their original price after the sale.

Each unique Outfit is purchasable once. Please ensure that you own the Resonator before purchasing their Outfit. You may purchase an Outfit without owning the corresponding Resonator, in which case the Outfit becomes usable once you own the Resonator for that Outfit.
new_translation_vi: [Trang phục]

source_en:
[About]

Maji, your good old friend, is back again with his "Brand New Lollo Campaign Plan." As always, your support is greatly appreciated. Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.
Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.

Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.

After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8

[Event Rules]
After the event starts, log in to the game to claim daily sign-in rewards. Sign-in records refresh daily at 04:00 server time.
After the event ends, any unclaimed sign-in rewards you earned will be reissued via in-game mail within 30 days upon your next login.
new_translation_vi: [Điều kiện]

source_en: Shooting the patrolling Vitreum Dancers with the "jewelry set" will paralyze them for a while. When all the Vitreum Dancers in the room are paralyzed, they will permanently stop patrolling.
new_translation_vi: Bắn vào những Vitreum Dancer đang tuần tra bằng "bộ trang sức" sẽ khiến chúng paralyze trong một thời gian. Khi tất cả Vitreum Dancer trong phòng bị tê liệt, chúng sẽ vĩnh viễn ngừng tuần tra.

source_en:
1. After unlocking Quick Sale, a dashed Quick Sale area will be automatically generated in the Cargo every time you open the Dock interface. Place your catches within this area during sailing for Quick Sale.

2. When the Quick Sale area is fully occupied, you can immediately sell all catches within or partially occupying the area.

3. Catches sold through Quick Sale fetch higher prices compared to dock sales.

4. Quick Sale is only available during sailing.
new_translation_vi: 1. Sau khi mở khóa Bán nhanh, một khu vực Bán nhanh nét đứt sẽ tự động được tạo trong Cargo mỗi khi bạn mở giao diện Dock. Hãy đặt các chiến lợi phẩm của bạn vào khu vực này trong khi chèo thuyền để Bán nhanh.

source_en:
1. Deliver the required fish based on the profile provided. Only normal species can be delivered—mutants are excluded.

2. To complete a delivery, place the fish onto the corresponding profile and rotate it until the shape and angle align perfectly.

3. If multiple deliveries are required, you can submit some required species and complete the remaining deliveries in future attempts.
new_translation_vi: 1. Giao loại cá được yêu cầu dựa trên hồ sơ được cung cấp. Chỉ các loài bình thường mới có thể được giao—các loài đột biến bị loại trừ.

source_en:
[Recommended Attributes]

On the Echo Selection page, use "Suggest" to open the filter. This allows you to check the most commonly used Mainstats and Substats for the current Resonator and quickly filter out suitable Echoes.

While switching between "All," "COST 1," "COST 3," and "COST 4" Echoes on the Echo List on the left, the recommended attributes will adjust accordingly.

[Recommended Sonata Effects]

On the Resonator - Echo page, use "Suggest" to check the most commonly used Sonata Effect for the current Resonator.

Use "Auto Equip" to equip all Echoes that best match the selected Sonata Effect.

On the Sonata Selection and Sonata Gallery pages, the most commonly used Sonata Effect for the current Resonator will be marked with a thumb-up icon.


[Data Updates]

The recommendations are based on data collected from recently active players and refresh every Wednesday at 00:00 (server time). Actual refresh may experience some delay.

If there is not enough data, default recommendations generated by the system will be displayed instead.
new_translation_vi: [Thuộc tính đề xuất]

source_en:
Echo Presets allow you to easily save and apply customized Echo lineups for your Resonator.

[Saving Presets]

Select the "Current Setup" column and use "Save As Preset" to save the equipped Echo lineup for the Resonator.

Each preset can be named to your liking. Please ensure the names follow local laws and regulations.

You can save up to 20 Echo Presets. If you reach the limit, you will need to delete an existing preset to create a new one.

[Applying Presets]

Select any saved preset and use "Apply" to equip the preset to the current Resonator.
new_translation_vi: Các Cài đặt sẵn Echo cho phép bạn dễ dàng lưu và áp dụng các đội hình Echo tùy chỉnh cho Resonator của mình.

source_en: [Event Rules] The Pioneer Association has picked the Nimbus Sanctum as the theme for an upcoming edition of Wutherium Geographic. To that end, the association has organized a special survey of the Nimbus Sanctum. Complete Survey Tasks and accumulate Survey Points to secure valuable rewards offered by the Pioneer Association. [Task Reset] Survey Tasks reset daily at 04:00. Upon reset, any unclaimed Survey Points will be automatically claimed, and uncompleted tasks will expire. If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
new_translation_vi: [Quy tắc sự kiện]

source_en: This Tacet Discord enters a defensive state when its Vibration Strength is low. Attack it by then to <color=#ffd12f>Break its hand defense</color> and <color=#ffd12f>immobilize</color> it.
new_translation_vi: Tacet Discord này tiến vào trạng thái phòng thủ khi Vibration Strength của nó thấp. Hãy tấn công nó vào lúc đó để <color=#ffd12f>Phá vỡ thế thủ tay</color> và <color=#ffd12f>làm tê liệt</color> nó.

source_en:
Interact with the Fishing Spot to fish.

Some Fishing Spots require specific Fishing Abilities. Acquire the corresponding Fishing Abilities to gain access to these spots.
new_translation_vi: Tương tác với Điểm câu cá để câu cá.

source_en:
You may switch between Fishing Abilities on your voyage with the wheel.

Using this feature wisely makes your fishing trips more efficient and rewarding.
new_translation_vi: Bạn có thể chuyển đổi giữa các Kỹ năng câu cá trong chuyến đi của mình bằng bánh xe.

source_en:
To catch the "biggest fish," you'll need a bigger ship. Captain Ahab has just one, but it really needs some repairs.

Provide Queequeg with a design print, logs, and Fishery Coins, and he'll handle the rest for you.
new_translation_vi: Để bắt được "con cá lớn nhất", bạn sẽ cần một con tàu lớn hơn. Thuyền trưởng Ahab chỉ có một chiếc, nhưng nó thực sự cần được sửa chữa.

source_en:
Some tracks within Averardo Vault are under maintenance. Use the switches to ensure the train stays on <color=#ffd12f>tracks that allow passage</color>.

If the train is on the wrong track, it will automatically return.
new_translation_vi: Một số đường ray trong Hầm Averardo đang được bảo trì. Sử dụng các công tắc để đảm bảo tàu vẫn đi trên <color=#ffd12f>đường ray cho phép đi qua</color>.

source_en: A device designed to switch train tracks. The displayed direction on the device shows the current track the train is following. Use the Clearance Device to change the track direction.
new_translation_vi: Một thiết bị được thiết kế để chuyển đổi đường ray tàu. Hướng hiển thị trên thiết bị cho thấy đường ray hiện tại mà tàu đang đi theo. Sử dụng Thiết bị Thông quan để thay đổi hướng đường ray.

source_en:
Use the Clearance Device to turn the hostile security Echoes in the vault into allies. In this state, they will prioritize the safety of the clearance holder above all else.
 
If an allied Echo is too far from the Clearance Device or the Clearance Device is not equipped, it will revert to its hostile state.
 
*Controllable Echoes are marked by a golden aura.
new_translation_vi: Sử dụng Thiết bị Thông quan để biến các Echo an ninh thù địch trong hầm thành đồng minh. Ở trạng thái này, chúng sẽ ưu tiên sự an toàn của người giữ thiết bị thông quan lên trên hết.

source_en:
Due to limited functionality, the Vitreum Dancer can only perform straight-line dashes in four directions. 

Keep it within the camera's authentication range to unlock security doors.
new_translation_vi: Do chức năng hạn chế, Vitreum Dancer chỉ có thể thực hiện các cú lao thẳng theo bốn hướng.

source_en: The <color=#ffd12f>hilt platform</color> of the Statue of Divine Justice radiates strong Remnant Energy. Before proceeding, adjust your gravity direction to be <color=#ffd12f>perpendicular to the platform</color>.
new_translation_vi: <color=#ffd12f>Bệ chuôi kiếm</color> của Tượng Công lý Thần thánh tỏa ra Năng lượng Tàn dư mạnh mẽ. Trước khi tiếp tục, hãy điều chỉnh hướng trọng lực của bạn sao cho <color=#ffd12f>vuông góc với bệ</color>.

source_en: Casting a <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> above the hilt platform will cause the Statue of Divine Justice to descend, triggering a section of the ruin to move.
new_translation_vi: Thi triển <color=#ffd12f>Plunging Attack</color> phía trên bệ chuôi kiếm sẽ khiến Tượng Công lý Thần thánh hạ xuống, kích hoạt một phần của tàn tích di chuyển.

source_en: [Event Rules] The Pioneer Association has picked Whisperwind Haven as the theme for an upcoming edition of Wutherium Geographic. To that end, the association has organized a special survey of Whisperwind Haven. Complete Survey Tasks and accumulate Survey Points to secure valuable rewards offered by the Pioneer Association. [Task Reset] Survey Tasks reset daily at 04:00. Upon reset, any unclaimed Survey Points will be automatically claimed, and uncompleted tasks will expire. If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail.
new_translation_vi: [Quy tắc sự kiện]

source_en:
[About]

To the north of Ragunna City lies Rinascita's largest fishing ground: the Riccioli Islands, an enticing destination for an intriguing adventure. Ready your sails and prepare for the vast blue waters, Captain!

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14 and complete the Main Quest "Through the Sea Thou Break" to unlock (complete quest "Silent as a Falling Leaf" for the best experience).

[Event Rules]

During the event, join Phoebe on a captivating voyage in the Riccioli Islands. Steer the Gondola "Rachel" and fish for unique, local species to boost your Fame and become a true fishing master!

Throughout the limited-time reward period, complete special goals to earn Nameless Coins. Collect enough Nameless Coins to claim the Rectifier "Ocean's Gift" (including its weapon projection).

Nameless Coins can be used to redeem rewards at the limited-time event shop. Please make sure to claim your rewards before the event concludes.

Any unclaimed rewards will be automatically sent to your mailbox if you log in within 30 days after the reward period. However, unredeemed rewards will not be delivered to your mailbox.

After the limited-time reward period, you can still participate in the event and claim the Chanty Bounty standard rewards.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
1. You can sell items from your Cargo at Planck's dock shop to earn Riccioli Fishery Coins.

2. You may purchase a variety of items from the Dock Shop with the Riccioli Fishery Coins. Keep in mind that available items may vary depending on the docks you visit.
new_translation_vi: 1. Bạn có thể bán các vật phẩm từ Cargo của mình tại cửa hàng bến tàu của Planck để kiếm Riccioli Fishery Coin.

source_en:
[About]
Beneath the iceberg of thought's deepest layers, all dreams are interconnected. Those neglected in the deep sea accumulate over time, merging and entangling in the abyss.
Now, the door to the Somnoire's depths has been opened—In this quiet place absent of wind or light, a mysterious person sends you an invitation to a film festival.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 30.

[Event Rules]
The Somnoire is pulsing with mysterious power. Upon entering, all Resonators are stripped of their Echoes, but in their place are Illusive Echoes, Metaphors, and other unique buffs waiting to be discovered.
Explore different team builds and combinations for diverse combat experiences.
This event features a new Bond system. Resonators can now form unique Bonds with each other, and as Bond level increases, it grants various combat buffs and powerful Synergy Burst.
Explore the Illusive Realm to earn generous rewards.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About]

Maji, a manager at Jinzhou Lollo Logistics, decides to launch a new Lollo Campaign. Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps, a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics.

Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]

Reach Union Level 14.

[Event Rules]

During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns once per day to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.

Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

There are 3 rounds of Inventory for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.

After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Details]
Event contents will be unlocked and claimable after specific time points.
Unclaimed contents will NOT be reissued via Mail once the event ends. Please remember to claim your rewards in time.
new_translation_vi: [Điều kiện]

source_en:
[About]
Familiar scenes now lie faded, stripped of the colors they once held. A picture book awaits your touch to bring its hues back to life.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Chapter II Prologue.

[Event Rules]
A new set of stages unlocks each day in this event, each offering three levels of difficulty: Easy, Normal, and Difficult. Complete a stage to earn rewards. Levels of higher difficulties will unlock once the previous ones are cleared.

Solve the puzzle of colors to claim your rewards!
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About]
KU-Ryan, a Black Shores robot, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on Waveworn Phenomena in Ragunna. Interested individuals are welcome to speak with him.
 
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue.
 
[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to activate challenges across different regions. You can participate in any activated challenge as many times as you want.
2. After the challenge starts, Surveillance Datasets will appear. Try to collect as many Surveillance Datasets as possible within the time limit. When all the datasets have been collected or when time runs out, you will receive rewards based on points obtained.
3. There are various modules available in the challenges. Utilize them strategically to speed up Dataset collection.
4. If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your mailbox when you log in again within 30 days.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About]
Suspended in the sky, Avinoleum Theological Seminary has become a shattered reflection of a glorious bygone era in Ragunna.
Step into this forsaken and forbidden land to search for the truth behind faith.
Obtain abundant rewards after completing this event.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and arrive at Avinoleum Theological Seminary in Main Quest Chapter II Act III "The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier."

[Event Rules]
This event is divided into three stages, unlocking as you progress in the Main Quest.
Complete the Event Quests to obtain abundant rewards.
Unclaimed rewards will remain available for 30 days after the event ends and will be sent via Mail when you log in during this period.

Please note, some quests in this event cannot be completed in Co-op Mode, and Quest Tracking is unavailable in certain areas of the game.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
Certain stages support progress saving when you quit mid-challenge. Upon re-entering the stage, you can choose to continue from your last save or start over.

Special Notes:
1. All saved progress has an expiration time. Once the time expires, your progress will be lost.
2. All saved progress will be wiped during version updates. Please pay attention to the updates and be sure to complete any in-progress challenges beforehand.
3. You can save up to 10 challenge progress at a time. When the limit is exceeded, the oldest save will be overwritten.
4. If a Rover gender change is made, all mid-challenge saves will be lost.
new_translation_vi: Một số màn chơi hỗ trợ lưu tiến trình khi bạn thoát giữa chừng thử thách. Khi vào lại màn chơi, bạn có thể chọn tiếp tục từ lần lưu cuối cùng hoặc bắt đầu lại.

source_en:
Vines formed from remnants of the Dark Tide entangle the hovering statues. Use <color=#ffd12f>Cartethyia's abilities</color> to purify the statues.

<color=#ffd12f>Purify nearby statues</color> to clear the corruption on connected statues.
new_translation_vi: Các dây leo hình thành từ tàn dư của Tide Bóng tối quấn lấy các bức tượng lơ lửng. Sử dụng <color=#ffd12f>khả năng của Cartethyia</color> để thanh tẩy các bức tượng.

source_en:
Cartethyia infuses the Gravity Calibrator with special energy. 
 
Use the Gravity Calibrator to <color=#ffd12f>change the gravity direction</color>, enabling access to unreachable areas.
new_translation_vi: Cartethyia truyền năng lượng đặc biệt vào Gravity Calibrator.

source_en: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} the direction indicator along the wheel to change the gravity. <color=#ffd12f>The yellow indicator shows the direction guided by Cartethyia</color>.
new_translation_vi: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Chạm PC=Nhấp Gamepad=Nhấn} chỉ báo hướng dọc theo bánh xe để thay đổi trọng lực. <color=#ffd12f>Chỉ báo màu vàng hiển thị hướng được dẫn dắt bởi Cartethyia</color>.
Gravity Calibrator sẽ phát ra ánh sáng có màu sắc khác nhau dựa trên hướng của trọng lực. Nó sẽ phát sáng:

source_en:
In certain waters, the Gondola will cruise along a fixed route.

Simply control the Gondola's left and right movement.
new_translation_vi: Ở một số vùng nước, Gondola sẽ di chuyển dọc theo một lộ trình cố định.

source_en:
Ride the Gondola and follow the light spark until you reach the end of the route. 
 
Pass through <color=#ffd12f>Power-up Rings</color> to maintain your cruising speed and avoid <color=#ffd12f>Obstacle Rings</color> along the way.
new_translation_vi: Đi Gondola và đi theo tia sáng cho đến khi bạn đến cuối lộ trình.

source_en: Twisted frequencies permeate the castle, giving birth to a Sonoro Sphere where past and future intertwine. <color=#ffd12f>Use the lamp given to you by Cantarella</color> in certain areas to travel between different dimensions.
new_translation_vi: Các tần số xoắn ốc lan tỏa khắp lâu đài, tạo ra một Sonoro Sphere nơi quá khứ và tương lai đan xen. <color=#ffd12f>Sử dụng chiếc đèn được Cantarella đưa cho bạn</color> ở một số khu vực nhất định để di chuyển giữa các chiều không gian khác nhau.

source_en:
Coming in contact with the <color=#ffd12f>umbrella of a Bouncy Jellyfish</color> will <color=#ffd12f>bounce</color> the Resonator upward.
 
<color=#ffd12f>You can only interact with Bouncy Jellyfish in the current dimension</color>. Bouncy Jellyfish from other dimensions appear as visions and cannot be interacted with.
new_translation_vi: Tiếp xúc với <color=#ffd12f>chiếc ô của Bouncy Jellyfish</color> sẽ <color=#ffd12f>nảy</color> Resonator lên trên.

source_en:
The Nimbus Wraith has left special pattern hints on the ground.
 
Follow its guidance and <color=#ffd12f>walk along the highlighted path as accurately as possible</color> using Sensor to complete the pattern.
new_translation_vi: Nimbus Wraith đã để lại các gợi ý mẫu đặc biệt trên mặt đất.

source_en: When Capitaneus adopts a defensive stance, <color=#ffd12f>attacking from behind</color> will cause the stance to break, turning the situation to your advantage.
new_translation_vi: Khi Capitaneus áp dụng tư thế phòng thủ, <color=#ffd12f>tấn công từ phía sau</color> sẽ khiến tư thế đó bị phá vỡ, xoay chuyển tình thế có lợi cho bạn.

source_en:
Attack the Sequence Mechanism continuously to fully charge it and unlock certain mechanisms and entrances. 

The charging progress is shown as the <color=yellow>highlighted portion</color>. The charge will begin to drop if you stop attacking.
new_translation_vi: Tấn công Sequence Mechanism liên tục để nạp đầy năng lượng cho nó và mở khóa một số cơ chế và lối vào.

source_en: Turn the Messenger Statue to the correct direction to activate the mechanism. Different mechanisms require you to turn the Statue in different ways and different directions. Look for nearby <color=yellow>hints</color> to solve the puzzle.
new_translation_vi: Xoay Messenger Statue theo đúng hướng để kích hoạt cơ chế. Các cơ chế khác nhau yêu cầu bạn xoay Tượng theo những cách khác nhau và hướng khác nhau. Hãy tìm các <color=yellow>gợi ý</color> gần đó để giải câu đố.

source_en: Strong airstreams flow through the activated ventilation tunnel. Follow Zani and stay within the <color=yellow>protection zone</color> created by her shield. Otherwise, you may be blown off course.
new_translation_vi: Các luồng không khí mạnh chảy qua đường hầm thông gió đã kích hoạt. Hãy đi theo Zani và ở trong <color=yellow>vùng bảo vệ</color> do lá chắn của cô ấy tạo ra. Nếu không, bạn có thể bị thổi bay khỏi lộ trình.

source_en:
Activate the drain on the spiral column to release water from the tunnel and create a new passage. 

Adjust the spiral column to control the water level.
new_translation_vi: Kích hoạt cống thoát nước trên cột xoắn ốc để xả nước khỏi đường hầm và tạo lối đi mới.

source_en: After each round of the Race, you'll see a Summary where you can view the Cubes met, the rewards earned, and other Race data. Close the Summary to move on to the next round!
new_translation_vi: Sau mỗi vòng Đua, bạn sẽ thấy một Tóm tắt nơi bạn có thể xem các Cube đã gặp, phần thưởng kiếm được và dữ liệu Đua khác. Đóng Tóm tắt để chuyển sang vòng tiếp theo!

source_en:
Conquer Abbowser Castle with your Cube companions to free the other trapped Cubes.

Utilize the resources in Abbowser Castle to level up your Cubes until you're ready to defeat Abbowser.

Gather all your Cubes and host the Ceremony together.
new_translation_vi: Chinh phục Lâu đài Abbowser cùng với những người bạn Cube của bạn để giải phóng các Cube bị mắc kẹt khác.

source_en:
Your rescued Cube companions from Abbowser Castle will help with Ceremony preparations.

As the preparation progresses, the Anniversary Cake will change in stages.

Freed Cubes will stick around in the Cube World. Maybe they'll have a story to share?
new_translation_vi: Những người bạn Cube được giải cứu từ Lâu đài Abbowser sẽ giúp chuẩn bị cho Lễ kỷ niệm.

source_en:
Cube companions will fight alongside your Resonators in Abbowser Castle. 

Use Echo Skills to make your Cubes cast <color=#ffd12f>powerful attacks</color>.

Some Cubes can even cast themselves to form Combos with Resonators or other Cubes.
new_translation_vi: Các người bạn Cube sẽ chiến đấu cùng với các Resonator của bạn trong Lâu đài Abbowser.

source_en:
Cubes can be equipped with Data Modules to gain extra powers in battle.

Data Modules come in many types. Be sure to <color=#ffd12f>equip them to the corresponding slot</color>.
new_translation_vi: Các Cube có thể được trang bị Data Module để đạt được sức mạnh bổ sung trong trận chiến.

source_en:
There are 3 types of Data Modules for your Cubes. 

Aside from Abbowser Castle, Abbowser's Shop also has powerful Data Modules. To shop there, collect the coins obtained by conquering Abbowser Castle.
new_translation_vi: Có 3 loại Data Module cho Cube của bạn.

source_en:
Equip Ability Modules to give your Cubes the Abilities of other Cubes. 
An Ability Module <color=#ffd12f>cannot be equipped</color> if the Cube already has <color=#ffd12f>that same ability</color>.
new_translation_vi: Trang bị Ability Module để cung cấp cho Cube của bạn các Kỹ năng của các Cube khác.

source_en: Players can <color=#ffd12f>support</color> a <color=#ffd12f>Cube</color> by <color=#ffd12f>predicting</color> that it will be the match <color=#ffd12f>Winner</color>.
new_translation_vi: Người chơi có thể <color=#ffd12f>ủng hộ</color> một <color=#ffd12f>Cube</color> bằng cách <color=#ffd12f>dự đoán</color> rằng nó sẽ là <color=#ffd12f>Người chiến thắng</color> trận đấu.

source_en: Each day from 8:00 to 19:30, players can support their favorite Cube by predicting that it will be the match winner. Each day, the match starts at 20:00, and the match winner will be decided on the same day.
new_translation_vi: Mỗi ngày từ 8:00 đến 19:30, người chơi có thể ủng hộ Cube yêu thích của mình bằng cách dự đoán rằng nó sẽ là người chiến thắng trận đấu. Mỗi ngày, trận đấu bắt đầu lúc 20:00 và người chiến thắng trận đấu sẽ được quyết định trong cùng ngày.

source_en:
In each match, the <color=#ffd12f>No. 1 Ranked</color> Cube wins. Players who <color=#ffd12f>supported</color> the winning Cube will <color=#ffd12f>receive</color> Popularity Rewards.

The Popularity Rewards are determined by the Popularity consumed in Support, and the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color>. These odds <color=#ffd12f>refresh regularly</color> based on how much Support the Cube receives.
new_translation_vi: Trong mỗi trận đấu, Cube <color=#ffd12f>Xếp hạng số 1</color> sẽ thắng. Những người chơi đã <color=#ffd12f>ủng hộ</color> Cube chiến thắng sẽ <color=#ffd12f>nhận được</color> Phần thưởng Phổ biến.

source_en: Each match is split into the 1st Half and 2nd Half. The rankings in the 2nd Half will determine whether a Cube <color=#ffd12f>advances</color> to the next match.
new_translation_vi: Mỗi trận đấu được chia thành Hiệp 1 và Hiệp 2. Thứ hạng trong Hiệp 2 sẽ quyết định liệu một Cube có <color=#ffd12f>tiến vào</color> trận đấu tiếp theo hay không.

source_en: When Cubes are stacked, if the bottom Cube moves first, it will carry along all the Cubes stacked above it. Among stacked Cubes, the higher up a Cube is, the higher its rank.
new_translation_vi: When Cubes are stacked, if the bottom Cube moves first, it will carry along all the Cubes stacked above it. Among stacked Cubes, the higher up a Cube is, the higher its rank.

source_en:
During the Support Phase, players can <color=#ffd12f>support</color> their favorite Cube by <color=#ffd12f>predicting</color> that it will be the <color=#ffd12f>Match Winner</color>.

<color=#ffd12f>Supporting</color> a Cube consumes a player's Popularity. <color=#ffd12f>Popularity</color> can be obtained by completing the event's <color=#ffd12f>Daily Tasks</color>.

If the Cube you Supported wins, you will <color=#ffd12f>receive Popularity Rewards</color> based on [Popularity Given] x [Underdog Odds].

Don't worry, you'll get back 80% of the Popularity you gave in Support if your prediction turns out wrong!

The Support Phase lasts from 08:00 to 19:30 every day.

Based on the Support a Cube receives and its starting position, the Cube's <color=#ffd12f>Underdog Odds</color> are <color=#ffd12f>refreshed</color> daily at 12:00 and 18:00. 

Your Popularity Rewards for correctly predicting the winner will depend on the Cube's Underdog Odds. Be sure to keep an eye on any changes to those odds!

source_en:
The Race Page shows all stages of the Race and who's advancing.

The Race consists of 5 stages: Group A, Group B, Quarterfinal A, Quarterfinal B, and the Final, with 10 matches in total.

During the Support Phase, the current Contenders and match will be highlighted. After each match is over, the page will update with the Contenders for the next match.

source_en:
Each Group Stage is split into the 1st Half and the 2nd Half.
A Cube's ranking in the 1st Half will determine its starting position in the 2nd Half.

After the 2nd Half ends, only the <color=#ffd12f>frontrunner Cubes</color> will <color=#ffd12f>advance to the next Stage</color>.

The top 4 ranking Cubes from each Group Stage will advance to the Quarterfinal Stage. The top 2 from the Quarterfinal Stage will move on to the Final, where the champion will be decided.

After each match ends, the Match Recap page will allow you to watch the match replay. 

If the match that just concluded was the 1st Half, a "2nd Half Starting Position" button will appear on the main page. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Click Gamepad=Press} to view the starting positions of the Cubes for the 2nd Half.

source_en:
[Patron Board]
1. The Patron Board is formed according to the results from supporting the Cubes. The top 100 players from your server will be displayed on the Patron Board.
2. Your ranking will also be available on the Patron Board. Your info will not be displayed on the Patron Board if you haven't supported a Cube or if your results are below 50% of the participants.
3. Rankings on the Patron Board are determined by total Popularity. Two or more players will have the same ranking if they have the same Popularity, with the order within the Patron Board determined by the number of correct predictions and the time at which they were made.
4. Only Popularity obtained from supporting Cubes counts toward the total Popularity Rankings. Popularity obtained from doing Daily Event Tasks will not be counted.
5. You need to have supported a Cube at least once to be ranked.
6. The Patron Board will show your avatar and name as it was when you supported the Cubes.
7. You will be removed from the current Patron Board if your name contains sensitive characters that violate the User Agreement. If abnormalities are detected during the Cube supporting process, the offending player's ranking data will be deleted, and they will be banned from the current rankings. The Dev Team reserves the right of final interpretation.

[Patron Board Update]
The Patron Board is updated at set times. Update times for each server are:
Mainland China: 04:00 (UTC+8)
HK, MO, TW: 04:00 (UTC+8)
SEA: 04:00 (UTC+8)
Asia: 04:00 (UTC+8)
America: 04:00 (UTC-5)
Europe: 04:00 (UTC+1)

1. The Patron Board will not be accessible during the Preliminary stage. After Preliminary B - 2nd, the rankings will be unlocked at 04:00 a.m. of the following day.
2. After each match, the rankings will be refreshed at 04:00 a.m. of the following day. There may be a slight delay before the Patron Board is updated with the latest rankings. We appreciate your patience.

source_en:
[Echo Aspect]
By switching Aspects, you can change the appearance of Echo Wings and Glider.

[Important Notes]
Each Echo Aspect can only be purchased once and can be used on all Resonators you own.
Echo Aspects have usage requirements. You must progress through Main Quest Chapter I Prologue to unlock Glider Aspect, and Main Quest Chapter II Act II to unlock Echo Wings Aspect.
You may purchase Aspects even if you haven't met the requirements yet. Once you meet them, the Aspects will become usable.

source_en:
[About]
The streets of Septimont are teeming with life. Travelers from near and far have gathered in their finest for the Great Agon.
Go explore Septimont in this time of celebration, taste the bitterness of defeat and joy of triumph in the competition, and experience the glory of the arena amidst stunning landscapes.

[Eligibility]
Arrive in Septimont during the Main Quest "Shadow of Glory."

[Event Rules]
The event has four phases, each unlocking progressively as you advance through the Main Quest.
Complete event quests to earn great rewards.
If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to receive the rewards via mail.
Please note that certain event content is not available while in Co-op mode, and event Quest Tracking is not available in certain areas.

[Dream Boon]
1. Clearing a Dreamland stage for the first time grants you a Lost Mirror Piece, which can be used to unlock Dream Boon buffs.

2. Each Dream Boon has its own unlock conditions. You need to unlock prerequisite nodes before progressing further.

source_en:
[Echo Management]
- You can create multiple management plans for Echoes based on quality, COST, Sonata Effects, and Mainstats.
- Multiple plans can be active at the same time. When a new Echo is obtained, it will automatically be locked or marked for discard according to the active plans.

[Echo Auto-discard]
If an Echo meets both lock and discard criteria, it will be locked rather than discarded.

[Suggested Plan]
You can directly import multiple suggested plans. The suggested plans do not cover all Sonata Effects and must be manually activated.
new_translation_vi: [Quản lý Echo]

source_en:
Fenrico may cast Holy Summon to summon Divine Envoys at his command and start channeling Retribution.
When Fenrico casts Holy Summon, Phrolova will charge up to counter the incoming Retribution.
Defeating the Divine Envoys ensures that Prolova's charge-up remains uninterrupted and allows her to generate a Remnant Field that defends Resonators inside against Retribution. After Retribution ends, Phrolova will counter Fenrico, lowering his vibration strength.
new_translation_vi: Fenrico có thể thi triển Holy Summon để triệu hồi Divine Envoys theo lệnh và bắt đầu vận chiêu Retribution.

source_en:
Micro Echo Brooders are stored centrally and require significant space. To preserve valuable manufacturing floor area, they are usually concealed within structural partitions.
These units deploy rapidly when activated and may bump into surrounding objects. You can control them via Orchestration.
new_translation_vi: Các Micro Echo Brooder được lưu trữ tập trung và yêu cầu không gian đáng kể. Để bảo toàn diện tích sàn sản xuất quý giá, chúng thường được giấu bên trong các vách ngăn cấu trúc.

source_en: Special music stands are found around the Orchestration Altar. Put a complete Music Sheet on the stand corresponding to the altar to activate the Orchestration Altar and initiate Polyphone Orchestration mode.
new_translation_vi: Các giá nhạc đặc biệt được đặt xung quanh Orchestration Altar. Đặt một bản nhạc hoàn chỉnh lên giá tương ứng với bàn thờ để kích hoạt Orchestration Altar và bắt đầu chế độ Polyphone Orchestration.

source_en: After connecting the numbers in ascending order, the missing notes on the top of the screen will be restored, and the Orchestration will be complete, returning the chaotic melody to its original form.
new_translation_vi: Sau khi kết nối các con số theo thứ tự tăng dần, những nốt nhạc còn thiếu ở phía trên màn hình sẽ được khôi phục, Orchestration sẽ hoàn tất và đưa giai điệu hỗn loạn trở về hình thái ban đầu.

source_en: Energy pipes supply large amounts of energy to various areas and connect to an array of opening and closing valves. Operate the valves by sending energy through the pipes to the correct place.
new_translation_vi: Các đường ống năng lượng cung cấp một lượng lớn năng lượng cho nhiều khu vực khác nhau và kết nối với một hệ thống các van đóng mở. Hãy vận hành các van bằng cách truyền năng lượng qua đường ống đến đúng vị trí.

source_en: The Prayer Rite must be performed exactly as specified by the Order of the Deep for it to be considered a display of devotion. Failure to do so warrants expulsion from the group.
new_translation_vi: Nghi thức cầu nguyện (Prayer Rite) phải được thực hiện chính xác theo quy định của Order of the Deep để được coi là một biểu hiện của lòng thành kính. Nếu không tuân thủ, bạn sẽ bị trục xuất khỏi nhóm.

source_en:
Echoes with this Dream Attribute center around <color=#ffd12f>Devouring</color> as their core ability. 
Certain Echoes grow stronger in the Dreamland by Devouring. <color=#ffd12f>When a powerful Echo absorbs a weak one, its Daily Coupon yield increases.</color>
Certain Echoes grant additional buffs upon being Devoured.

To maximize your gains, <color=#ffd12f>make sure you have enough Echoes on the field that can be Devoured</color> if you select Dream of Devouring.
new_translation_vi: Các Echo mang Thuộc tính Dream này tập trung vào <color=#ffd12f>Devouring</color> làm khả năng cốt lõi.

source_en: Echoes with this Dream Attribute have no core ability. <color=#ffd12f>They are suited for synergizing with Echoes of other Dream Attributes.</color> These Echoes will automatically be added to Echo Recruitment after being unlocked, without the need to specifically select this Dream Attribute.
new_translation_vi: Các Echo mang Thuộc tính Dream này không có khả năng cốt lõi. <color=#ffd12f>Chúng phù hợp để phối hợp với các Echo mang Thuộc tính Dream khác.</color> Các Echo này sẽ tự động được thêm vào Tuyển mộ Echo sau khi được mở khóa mà không cần phải chọn cụ thể Thuộc tính Dream này.

source_en:
[About]
Maji, the idea king, is back with yet another new campaign—
This time, he's riding the tech wave and trying to create his very own smart assistant, Lollo Genie.
Interact with adorable Echoes and submit their behavioural data to Maji to collect Lollo Stamps and participate in the thrilling lottery!

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete Main Quest Chapter II Prologue.

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps. Each Lollo Stamp lets you peel off one Lollo Campaign lottery ticket.
After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en: Hold the hand-holding icon to release Iuno's hand. Moving more than 5 meters away from her specter will break the Anchoring and cause you to become lost in the Chaos. If you do not take her hand again within 15 seconds, the Anchoring will end, and you will return to the last Anchored memory.
new_translation_vi: Giữ biểu tượng nắm tay để buông tay Iuno. Di chuyển cách xa bóng ma của cô ấy hơn 5 mét sẽ phá vỡ sự kết nối (Anchoring) và khiến bạn bị lạc trong Hỗn mang. Nếu bạn không nắm tay cô ấy lại trong vòng 15 giây, sự kết nối sẽ kết thúc và bạn sẽ quay trở lại ký ức được kết nối gần nhất.

source_en: In this battle against the Dark Tide, Iuno can use certain skills to heal allied Gladiators nearby. After reaching a certain amount of health, Gladiators will return to combat.
new_translation_vi: Trong trận chiến chống lại Dark Tide này, Iuno có thể sử dụng một số kỹ năng nhất định để hồi máu cho các Gladiator đồng minh gần đó. Sau khi đạt đến một lượng máu nhất định, các Gladiator sẽ quay trở lại chiến đấu.

source_en: Insert the <color=#ffd12f>Anchor Stone</color> into the <color=#ffd12f>Anchor Obelisk</color> to activate it. Once activated, it repels the Dark Tide fog and boosts the Sacred Flames in Maroonwood.
new_translation_vi: Đặt <color=#ffd12f>Anchor Stone</color> vào <color=#ffd12f>Anchor Obelisk</color> để kích hoạt nó. Sau khi kích hoạt, nó sẽ đẩy lùi sương mù Dark Tide và tăng cường Ngọn lửa Thiêng (Sacred Flames) trong Maroonwood.

source_en: The awakened Hollow Figure can be <color=#ffd12f>shattered</color>. Approaching a Hollow Figure will cause it to <color=#ffd12f>charge up</color> and explode, thus summoning Tacet Discords. <color=#ffd12f>Shattering</color> the Hollow Figure before it completes <color=#ffd12f>charging up</color> can prevent the summoning.
new_translation_vi: Hollow Figure đã thức tỉnh có thể bị <color=#ffd12f>phá vỡ</color>. Tiếp cận một Hollow Figure sẽ khiến nó <color=#ffd12f>tích tụ năng lượng</color> và phát nổ, từ đó triệu hồi các Tacet Discord. <color=#ffd12f>Phá vỡ</color> Hollow Figure trước khi nó hoàn tất quá trình <color=#ffd12f>tích tụ</color> có thể ngăn chặn việc triệu hồi.

source_en:
Interact with the Dreamscape Nodes in the Sanguis Plateaus to unlock the challenges and clear the Nightmares sealed within.
There are three challenges in a Node. Completing a challenge unlocks the next one. Complete all challenges to obtain rewards.
new_translation_vi: Tương tác với các Dreamscape Node trong Sanguis Plateaus để mở khóa các thử thách và xóa bỏ những cơn Ác mộng bị phong ấn bên trong.

source_en:
There are three terrain types in the Tidal Defense Simulator: ground, wall and ceiling. Combat Machines can only be deployed on specific terrain based on their type.

In each Preparation phase, you will receive a certain number of Sim Credits. You will also earn a small number of Sim Credits by defeating Tacet Discords.
new_translation_vi: Có ba loại địa hình trong Tidal Defense Simulator: mặt đất, tường và trần nhà. Combat Machine chỉ có thể được triển khai trên địa hình cụ thể dựa trên loại của chúng.

source_en:
Tacet Discords enter through invasion points. During the simulation, they won't attack you directly but will follow preset routes. You can see these routes as marked lines in the Preparation phase.

Additionally, the Preparation phase shows previews of Tacet Discords moving along these paths. Use this info to strategically deploy your Combat Machines based on their movement patterns.
new_translation_vi: Tacet Discord xâm nhập qua các điểm xâm nhập. Trong quá trình mô phỏng, chúng sẽ không tấn công bạn trực tiếp mà sẽ đi theo các lộ trình được thiết lập sẵn. Bạn có thể thấy các lộ trình này dưới dạng các đường kẻ được đánh dấu trong giai đoạn Chuẩn bị.

source_en:
After completing a simulation, you'll be granted Rating Stars based on the remaining Durability of the Energy Matrix.

Rating Stars can be used to unlock Overwatch Protocols, granting tactical advantages for future simulations.
new_translation_vi: Sau khi hoàn thành một mô phỏng, bạn sẽ được trao Rating Star dựa trên Độ bền còn lại của Energy Matrix.

source_en:
In Deathtrap Mode, you'll be able to choose a Tactic during the Preparation stage before each wave. Tactics grant powerful combat buffs.

Each Tactic belongs to a specific Tactic Set, where you can view detailed descriptions and effects.
new_translation_vi: Trong Chế độ Deathtrap, bạn sẽ có thể chọn một Chiến thuật (Tactic) trong giai đoạn Chuẩn bị trước mỗi đợt tấn công. Các Chiến thuật mang lại những buff chiến đấu mạnh mẽ.

source_en:
Use the wheel to quickly switch between your carried items.
You can only carry a limited number of items. Different items have different carry limits. Once you reach the limit, you won't be able to purchase more.
new_translation_vi: Sử dụng bánh xe để nhanh chóng chuyển đổi giữa các vật phẩm bạn mang theo.

source_en: Once samples of the same Attribute are connected, all other single samples of that Attribute will become fixed. Drag the connected samples to link with the fixed ones.
new_translation_vi: Sau khi các mẫu cùng Thuộc tính được kết nối, tất cả các mẫu đơn lẻ khác của Thuộc tính đó sẽ được cố định. Kéo các mẫu đã kết nối để liên kết với các mẫu đã cố định.

source_en:
[Terminal Swap]
Once a new Terminal is obtained, you can swap Terminals in the Terminal page. Terminals not yet acquired will not be shown.
Terminal Swap can only be applied to Rover, and is not available to other Resonators. Changing Rover's gender does not affect the current Terminal configuration.
new_translation_vi: [Thay đổi Terminal]

source_en:
[Eye Comfort]
Eye Comfort adjusts screen display for easier viewing, except for cutscenes and UI elements.
It comes with three modes: [Low Light], [Bright Light], and [Custom], which can be selected according to the current user environment.
In Custom mode, you can adjust color temperature, intensity, brightness, and texture intensity.
Please note that the Eye Comfort feature is not compatible with Global Filter.
new_translation_vi: [Eye Comfort]

source_en:
In this simulation, some Tacet Discords are Shielded. Shielded Tacet Discords are immune to Slow effects.

Use pulling-in-type Combat Machines (Vortex Generator and Whirlpool Device) to directly remove Tacet Discords' Shields.
new_translation_vi: Trong mô phỏng này, một số Tacet Discord được bảo vệ bởi Khiên. Các Tacet Discord có Khiên sẽ miễn nhiễm với các hiệu ứng Slow.

source_en: When Tacet Discords with Deathsound - Contamination are <color=#ffd12f>defeated</color>, they release Frequency Contamination on the spot. Combat Machines cannot be deployed in the contaminated areas, and the already deployed ones <color=#ffd12f>become disabled</color>.
new_translation_vi: Khi các Tacet Discord có Deathsound - Contamination bị <color=#ffd12f>đánh bại</color>, chúng sẽ giải phóng Frequency Contamination tại chỗ. Combat Machine không thể được triển khai trong các khu vực bị ô nhiễm và những máy đã triển khai sẽ <color=#ffd12f>bị vô hiệu hóa</color>.

source_en:
[About]
You receive a new message from the Hunter's Den: Please examine the traces left by TDs and track them down.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and complete the first hunt in the Main Quest "By Sun's Burning Hand."

[Event Rules]
1. The event unlocks a new set of samples each day. Each set contains samples that pose Easy, Normal, and Expert levels of challenge. Complete analyzing the corresponding samples to unlock the rewards.
2. To challenge the more difficult samples in the same set, you need to first complete the analysis of the previous sample.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About]
The Lollo Campaign is facing an unexpected crisis! To save Maji's old reliable delivery legs, and to keep those convenient services running, help him complete his new program, Lollo Ice Drinks! Complete the campaigns to claim your Lollo Stamps—a gift of gratitude from Lollo Logistics. Lollo Stamps can be exchanged for Lollo Helper special deliveries.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and Complete Main Quest Chapter II Act V "Shadow of Glory"

[Event Rules]
During the event, you can complete Lollo Campaigns to obtain a set number of Lollo Stamps.

Each Lollo Stamp can be exchanged for a Lollo Helper special delivery.

There are 3 Inventories for the Lollo Helper special deliveries. Once you collect all deliveries in an Inventory, the next Inventory will be unlocked.

If you win the Lollo Express special delivery service, you can claim all deliveries in the current Inventory.

After the event ends, the unfinished Lollo Campaigns will not be available, and all the remaining Lollo Stamps will be recycled.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
1. Complete stage objectives to earn Rating Stars, which can be used to unlock new Overwatch Protocols.
2. These Protocols enhance your performance in the simulation.
3. Higher-level Protocols require you to unlock lower-tier ones first.
new_translation_vi: 1. Hoàn thành các mục tiêu giai đoạn để kiếm Rating Star, có thể được sử dụng để mở khóa Overwatch Protocol mới.

source_en:
1. You can view the stats and effects of all the Combat Machines and KU-Roro's Weapons on this page.

2. You can upgrade and strengthen them using Sim Ingots earned after completing a stage. 
Reaching Level 3 unlocks Optional Modules for Combat Machines, allowing you to customize and improve their combat efficiency based on your strategy.

3. All upgrades can be reset for a full Sim Ingot refund.

4. Please note that upgrades and module changes cannot be made during a wave of attack.
new_translation_vi: 1. Bạn có thể xem chỉ số và hiệu ứng của tất cả Combat Machine và Vũ khí của KU-Roro trên trang này.

source_en:
[About]
KU-Ryan, a Black Shores robot, is currently looking for help in gathering Surveillance Datasets on Waveworn Phenomena in Septimont. Interested individuals are welcome to speak with him.
 
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 14 and successfully collapse the experimental unit during the Main Quest "Shadow of Glory."
 
[Event Rules]
1. During the event, you need to activate challenges across different locations. You can participate in any activated challenge as many times as you want.
2. After the challenge starts, Surveillance Datasets will appear. Try to collect as many Surveillance Datasets as possible within the time limit. When all the datasets have been collected or when time runs out, you will receive rewards based on the points obtained.
3. There are various modules available in the challenges. Utilize them strategically to speed up Dataset collection.
4. If there are any unclaimed rewards after the event ends, they will be automatically sent to your inbox when you log in again within 30 days.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8.

[Event Rules]
The rewards of the Gifts of the Moon Roamer event will be unlocked after the specified time and date.
Note that all rewards of this event will NOT be reissued via in-game Mail once the event ends. Please remember to participate and claim your rewards in time.
new_translation_vi: [Điều kiện tham gia]

source_en: Distorted temporal zones exist throughout the Plane of Dark Tide. Use the Lantern of Napoli the Second to separate and switch between "worlds" in the Dark Tide.
new_translation_vi: Các vùng thời gian bị biến dạng tồn tại khắp Plane of Dark Tide. Sử dụng Lantern of Napoli the Second để tách biệt và chuyển đổi giữa các "thế giới" trong Dark Tide.

source_en:
During the drill, defeating TDs yields Enhancement Modules. You can spend them in the Shop between waves to upgrade Resonators, Weapons, or purchase Items.
Survive the required waves to complete the challenge.
new_translation_vi: Trong quá trình huấn luyện, đánh bại TD sẽ mang lại Enhancement Module. Bạn có thể chi tiêu chúng trong Cửa hàng giữa các đợt tấn công để nâng cấp Resonator, Vũ khí hoặc mua Vật phẩm.

source_en: In Easy Mode, performing the designated action with the required Resonator automatically triggers <color=#ffd12f>Slow Motion</color>, allowing you to observe and capture the Resonator's action precisely.
new_translation_vi: Trong Chế độ Dễ, thực hiện hành động được chỉ định với Resonator yêu cầu sẽ tự động kích hoạt <color=#ffd12f>Slow Motion</color>, cho phép bạn quan sát và nắm bắt hành động của Resonator một cách chính xác.

source_en:
In Hard Mode, Freeze Frame objectives are less obvious. You must try to find the correct combat actions.
In Hard Mode, Slow Motion no longer triggers automatically. You need to <color=#ffd12f>manually activate the Slow Motion gadget</color> to slow time.
new_translation_vi: Trong Chế độ Khó, các mục tiêu Freeze Frame ít rõ ràng hơn. Bạn phải cố gắng tìm ra các hành động chiến đấu chính xác.

source_en:
[About] 
Green and hazy as they may feel, school days always shine like gems in the river of memory. Those stories drift among the stars, your constant companions through every quiet night. 
As the New Solar Celebration unfolds, fresh little tales begin to blossom between you and your friends...  

[Eligibility] 
Solve the first riddle with Sigrika in Main Quest "Gold Suspended in Shadows" to unlock

[Rules] 
Progress the Main Quest to unlock the events of the corresponding Resonators. Certain conditions are required to unlock some of the events. Complete "Whispers Between Stars" to earn exclusive rewards, including Astrites and a Livery.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
Namipon Stickers can be obtained by eliminating Tacet Discords, breaking destructible objects, or opening Supply Chests.
Stickers come in different types, which offer different enhancements and base stats.
new_translation_vi: Namipon Sticker có thể nhận được bằng cách tiêu diệt Tacet Discord, phá vỡ các vật thể có thể phá hủy hoặc mở Rương cung cấp.

source_en:
Although the looping crisis is over, there are still unresolved mysteries in Honami City.
Explore Honami City with Namipon and Chisa in search of loot to enhance your combat power and upgrade Shashou Cafe. Uncover the truths behind the anomalies in the city!
new_translation_vi: Mặc dù cuộc khủng hoảng vòng lặp đã kết thúc, vẫn còn những bí ẩn chưa được giải đáp ở Honami City.

source_en:
Unlock more Namipon Support and Namipon Stickers as you investigate and venture into yet unexplored areas in search of valuable loot.
Build up your team's abilities as you plumb the depths of Honami City!
new_translation_vi: Mở khóa thêm Namipon Support và Namipon Sticker khi bạn điều tra và mạo hiểm vào những khu vực chưa được khám phá để tìm kiếm chiến lợi phẩm có giá trị.

source_en: Aside from Stickers, Honami City is filled with unique collectible items that, while lacking practical effects, hold significant value. These loot items can be sold to the Sales Champ in exchange for Rice Dangos, which can be spent to enhance your exploration abilities in Honami City.
new_translation_vi: Ngoài Sticker, Honami City còn chứa đầy các vật phẩm sưu tầm độc đáo, mặc dù thiếu các hiệu ứng thực tế nhưng lại có giá trị đáng kể. Những chiến lợi phẩm này có thể được bán cho Sales Champ để đổi lấy Rice Dango, có thể được sử dụng để nâng cao khả năng khám phá của bạn trong Honami City.

source_en: Honami City is now open to free exploration. Aside from the Telephone Booth, you can also book the Namipon Shuttle from the Preparations menu. Ticking that option allows you the freedom to extract at any time.
new_translation_vi: Honami City hiện đã mở cửa cho việc khám phá tự do. Ngoài bốt điện thoại, bạn cũng có thể đặt Namipon Shuttle từ menu Chuẩn bị. Đánh dấu tùy chọn đó cho phép bạn tự do rút lui bất cứ lúc nào.

source_en:
[About]
Lahai-Roi's route network, along with the Spacetrek Observatory that used to monitor its terrain, ecosystem, and climate, has been devastated by a Void Storm. It's time to rebuild them all!
Use rebuild materials gathered in Lahai-Roi to assist Dhalifa in restoring the Route Network and the Spacetrek Observatory.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and complete Tutorial Quest "Operation: Frontier Renewal"

[Event Rules]
Explore Lahai-Roi and use 3 types of materials to rebuild 10 routes.
Reaching a Route Constructor unlocks it as a Fast Travel point.
Once activated, the Constructor will automatically complete the route rebuild. Restored routes will revitalize the surrounding area, unlocking a variety of side quests and challenges.
Each completed route increases Network Activity. Reaching certain Activity milestones advances the Spacetrek Observatory's rebuild progress.

This event is permanently available. From Version 3.0 onward, you can access this event via the Region Guide on the Lahai-Roi map.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About]
After the end of Honami's City looping crisis, Namipon from Shashou Cafe contacts you to request your and Chisa's help in investigating a series of strange occurrences throughout Honami City.
Assist Namipon with the investigation while also gathering supplies to renovate Shashou Cafe.

[Eligibility]
Complete Main Quest Chapter II - Segue "Flowing Starlight in the Iris."
Reach Union Level 14

[Rules]
Explore the strange occurrences in Honami City and unravel their stories in the Stranger Things in Honami event.
Find loot to sell for revenue or to upgrade your combat power as you explore.
Resources gathered during exploration can be used to upgrade Shashou Cafe's Decor to provide support for your Resonators.
Due to the prevailing Lament Residue, Resonators cannot equip their Echoes, and downed Resonators cannot be revived by normal means.
Large amounts of Rice Dango rewards can be obtained by clearing Neon Tower challenges.
Limited-time rewards cannot be claimed once the reward window ends, but you can continue playing to earn permanent rewards.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
When exploring Honami City, after bringing any Legendary Quality unequippable loot item back to Shashou Cafe for the first time, that item will be displayed in the Gallery.
Even if you later sell that item from the Warehouse, it will remain displayed in the Gallery.
new_translation_vi: Khi khám phá Honami City, sau khi mang bất kỳ vật phẩm chiến lợi phẩm không thể trang bị có Chất lượng Huyền thoại nào về Shashou Cafe lần đầu tiên, vật phẩm đó sẽ được hiển thị trong Gallery.

source_en:
After activating a Namipon Lightbox, you can teleport back to its location while exploring.
However, after you leave the area, the Lightbox must be reactivated before you can teleport to it again.
new_translation_vi: Sau khi kích hoạt Namipon Lightbox, bạn có thể dịch chuyển tức thời trở lại vị trí của nó trong khi khám phá.

source_en:
[About]
New players may receive bonus rewards and unlock new Support Resonators through this event to aid their leveling.

[Eligibility]
Create a character profile after 2025-12-12 04:00 (server time) during the event.

[Rules]
The Herald of New Tides event lasts for 30 days.
During the event, upon unlocking new SOL3 Phases, new players may claim the Astrite and Data Bank EXP rewards along with 5-Star Support Resonators: Yinlin, Jinhsi, Changli, Shorekeeper, and Camellya.
During the event, to fast-track leveling for new players, you will enjoy access to locations that contain the upgrade materials and the recommended Echoes of the current Featured Resonators and New Voyage Resonators.
(Note: Support Resonators can only join you in the overworld and certain recurring Sonoro Spheres)
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
[About]
Join the Lahai-Roi Pioneer Project launched by the Spacetrek Collective! Explore every corner of Lahai-Roi, uncover its wonders, and earn rewards along the way.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and arrive at Startorch Academy during Main Quest "What Burns Beneath Frostlands" to unlock.

[Event Rules]
Complete event tasks to collect Exploration Data, then use it to raise your Pioneer Level. Higher levels unlock even greater rewards.
Please note that some event tasks can't be completed in Co-op Mode, and the quest-tracking feature may be disabled in certain game scenarios.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en:
1. The Region Guide shows the exclusive gameplays and features of each region. You can quickly view, find, and access the exclusive content of different regions here.
2. The specific gameplays or features in unlocked regions can be pinned. This will mark the pinned gameplay or feature on the map interface. You can pin up to 2 gameplays and/or features.
new_translation_vi: 1. Region Guide hiển thị các lối chơi và tính năng độc quyền của từng khu vực. Bạn có thể nhanh chóng xem, tìm và truy cập nội dung độc quyền của các khu vực khác nhau tại đây.

source_en:
You can upgrade Expansion Modules with Modding Points under the following conditions:
1. Specialized Modules can be upgraded after the preceding module has been upgraded to Lv. 1.
2. Core Modules can be upgraded with sufficient Modding Points.
new_translation_vi: Bạn có thể nâng cấp Expansion Module bằng Modding Point trong các điều kiện sau:

source_en:
Expansion Modules have their corresponding Modding Points and Modding Tasks.
Modding Tasks are either Permanent, Limited-Time, or Recurring.
Limited-Time tasks have to be completed within the specified time. They cannot be progressed any further once time is up, and rewards are not granted for uncompleted Limited-Time Tasks.
Limited-Time Tasks in this game version will be replaced with Recurring Tasks after the next game version update. Recurring Tasks are also permanent. You may complete the Recurring Tasks to earn the needed points for the corresponding Expansion Module.
new_translation_vi: Expansion Module có Modding Point và Modding Task tương ứng.

source_en:
You may project Echoes by equipping unlocked Echoes from the Gallery into the Projector via the Utility Wheel panel. 
When in a designated area, projected Echos can perform special skills to help you solve puzzles.
new_translation_vi: Bạn có thể chiếu Echo bằng cách trang bị các Echo đã mở khóa từ Gallery vào Projector thông qua bảng Utility Wheel.

source_en:
[About]
Lahai-Roi's route network, along with the Spacetrek Observatory that used to monitor its terrain, ecosystem, and climate, has been devastated by a Void Storm. It's time to rebuild them all!
Use rebuild materials gathered in Lahai-Roi to assist Dhalifa in restoring the Route Network and the Spacetrek Observatory.

[Eligibility]
Reach Union Level 8 and complete Tutorial Quest "Operation: Frontier Renewal"

[Event Rules]
Explore Lahai-Roi and use 3 types of materials to rebuild 10 routes.
Reaching a Route Constructor unlocks it as a Fast Travel point.
Once activated, the Constructor will automatically complete the route rebuild. Restored routes will revitalize the surrounding area, unlocking a variety of side quests and challenges.
Each completed route increases Network Activity. Reaching certain Activity milestones advances the Spacetrek Observatory's rebuild progress.

This event is permanently available. From Version 3.0 onward, you can access this event via the Region Guide on the Lahai-Roi map.
new_translation_vi: [Giới thiệu]

source_en: You can summon the expedition motorbike or adjust the relevant settings via the Utility Wheel. The motorbike cannot be summoned while in combat or when there is insufficient space.
new_translation_vi: Bạn có thể triệu hồi xe máy thám hiểm hoặc điều chỉnh các cài đặt liên quan thông qua Utility Wheel. Xe máy không thể được triệu hồi khi đang chiến đấu hoặc khi không đủ không gian.

source_en:
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the Autopilot button to enter Autopilot Mode.
During this time, Cinematic Mode can be switched on, and the game's aspect ratio will change, and automatic camera movement will occur.
new_translation_vi: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} nút Autopilot để vào Chế độ Autopilot.

source_en: After placing a navigation waypoint, a recommended route will be plotted along the highway to the waypoint on the map. Once you are within range of the highway, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Autopilot to arrive near your destination.
new_translation_vi: Sau khi đặt điểm tham chiếu điều hướng, một lộ trình được đề xuất sẽ được vẽ dọc theo đường cao tốc đến điểm tham chiếu trên bản đồ. Khi bạn ở trong phạm vi của đường cao tốc, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Autopilot để đến gần điểm đến của bạn.

source_en: On maps that support Autopilot, you can set specific markers as the destination. A recommended route will be plotted on the current road network, allowing you to reach the destination manually or via Autopilot.
new_translation_vi: Trên các bản đồ hỗ trợ Autopilot, bạn có thể đặt các điểm đánh dấu cụ thể làm điểm đến. Một lộ trình được đề xuất sẽ được vẽ trên mạng lưới đường bộ hiện tại, cho phép bạn đến đích theo cách thủ công hoặc thông qua Autopilot.

source_en: Autopilot Mode allows free camera movement and will automatically avoid obstacles (such as traffic) on the road. During Autopilot, feel free to move around the camera, listen to the Heart Radio Channel, take photos, and switch to Cinematic Mode when available.
new_translation_vi: Chế độ Autopilot cho phép di chuyển camera tự do và sẽ tự động tránh các chướng ngại vật (như giao thông) trên đường. Trong khi Autopilot, hãy thoải mái di chuyển camera, nghe Kênh Heart Radio, chụp ảnh và chuyển sang Chế độ Điện ảnh khi có sẵn.

source_en: On highways, Autopilot Mode can still be activated even without a destination, and the expedition motorbike will loop along a designated route on the current road network until you exit the mode.
new_translation_vi: Trên đường cao tốc, Chế độ Autopilot vẫn có thể được kích hoạt ngay cả khi không có điểm đến và xe máy thám hiểm sẽ chạy vòng quanh theo một lộ trình được chỉ định trên mạng lưới đường bộ hiện tại cho đến khi bạn thoát khỏi chế độ này.

source_en: Three specific materials are required to activate the Route Constructor: <color=#ffd12f>Mechanite</color>, <color=#ffd12f>Compressed Bedrock</color>, and <color=#ffd12f>Constructor Core</color>. Each material can be acquired via different methods.
new_translation_vi: Ba vật liệu cụ thể là bắt buộc để kích hoạt Route Constructor: <color=#ffd12f>Mechanite</color>, <color=#ffd12f>Compressed Bedrock</color> và <color=#ffd12f>Constructor Core</color>. Mỗi vật liệu có thể đạt được thông qua các phương pháp khác nhau.

source_en: After completing the route network's reconstruction, use the expedition motorbike's Autopilot Mode to quickly travel to the next Route Constructor and conduct subsequent reconstruction work.
new_translation_vi: Sau khi hoàn thành việc xây dựng lại mạng lưới lộ trình, hãy sử dụng Chế độ Autopilot của xe máy thám hiểm để nhanh chóng di chuyển đến Route Constructor tiếp theo và tiến hành công việc xây dựng lại tiếp theo.

source_en:
Continue tracking the locations of remaining Route Constructors to complete the route network's reconstruction.
During your exploration, <color=#ffd12f>material collection</color> can be conducted across <color=#ffd12f>various locations in Lahai-Roi</color>.
Each route network completion <color=#ffd12f>increases Network Activity</color>.
new_translation_vi: Tiếp tục theo dõi vị trí của các Route Constructor còn lại để hoàn thành việc xây dựng lại mạng lưới lộ trình.

source_en:
Once Network Activity <color=#ffd12f>reaches a certain point</color>, project missions become available to further the <color=#ffd12f>Spacetrek Observatory reconstruction project phase</color>.
Completing the Spacetrek Observatory's reconstruction unlocks Weather Simulation, which enables players to change the weather in the Lahai-Roi region.
new_translation_vi: Khi Network Activity <color=#ffd12f>đạt đến một điểm nhất định</color>, các nhiệm vụ dự án sẽ khả dụng để thúc đẩy <color=#ffd12f>giai đoạn dự án xây dựng lại Spacetrek Observatory</color>.

source_en:
When Hyvatia opens its Eye of Prediction, it observes and records Resonators' Dodges and Counterattacks.
Afterwards, Hyvatia's next attack cannot be Dodged or Counterattacked.
new_translation_vi: Khi Hyvatia mở Eye of Prediction, nó quan sát và ghi lại các pha Né tránh và Phản công của Resonator.

source_en: After attacking or taking Counterattacks several times, a Vulnerable Core will be exposed on Reactor Husk's left arm. Attacking the exposed core will destroy Reactor Husk's armor, rendering it unable to attack.
new_translation_vi: Sau khi tấn công hoặc thực hiện Phản công nhiều lần, một Vulnerable Core sẽ bị lộ trên cánh tay trái của Reactor Husk. Tấn công vào lõi bị lộ sẽ phá hủy giáp của Reactor Husk, khiến nó không thể tấn công.

source_en:
Inside the Solisylum, the Heliogyre has been deactivated.
Rotate six <color=#ffd12f>Stars</color> to realign their beams toward the Heliogyre and reactivate it.
new_translation_vi: Bên trong Solisylum, Heliogyre đã bị vô hiệu hóa.

source_en: During Exploration Quest “Where Light Takes Shape,” Rovers will need to gather Soliskin, which will accompany you as you travel through <color=#ffd12f>Bjartr Woods</color>.
new_translation_vi: Trong Nhiệm vụ Khám phá “Where Light Takes Shape,” Rover sẽ cần thu thập Soliskin, thứ sẽ đồng hành cùng bạn khi bạn di chuyển qua <color=#ffd12f>Bjartr Woods</color>.

source_en: While inside the giant trees of Solvein Canopy, certain devices can only be activated with the help of the Soliskin's powers. Locate the <color=#ffd12f>Solis Orb</color>, and assemble enough Soliskin to activate these devices.
new_translation_vi: Khi ở bên trong những cái cây khổng lồ của Solvein Canopy, một số thiết bị chỉ có thể được kích hoạt với sự trợ giúp của sức mạnh Soliskin. Tìm <color=#ffd12f>Solis Orb</color> và tập hợp đủ Soliskin để kích hoạt các thiết bị này.

source_en:
If you leave Bjartr Woods during the quest, Soliskin will stay and rest in the Woods until you return.
After the quest is completed, Soliskin return to Solvein Canopy and will no longer follow you.
new_translation_vi: Nếu bạn leave Bjartr Woods trong nhiệm vụ, Soliskin sẽ ở lại và nghỉ ngơi trong Rừng cho đến khi bạn quay lại.

source_en: You may view and equip all available Echoes in the edit page. Use Utility: Projector to call out the selection menu and choose the Echo to be projected. Some areas present puzzles that require special interactions. Use the Projector to create the appropriate Echo Projection to help your exploration.
new_translation_vi: Bạn có thể xem và trang bị tất cả các Echo khả dụng trong trang chỉnh sửa. Sử dụng Utility: Projector để gọi menu lựa chọn và chọn Echo để chiếu. Một số khu vực có các câu đố yêu cầu tương tác đặc biệt. Sử dụng Projector để tạo Echo Projection phù hợp nhằm hỗ trợ việc khám phá của bạn.

source_en: Geospiders S4 in Lahai-Roi gravitate towards places bathed in Lumiglow where they perform Lumiglow Revelation. Once the revelation is complete, the Lumiglow fades, revealing the hidden objects inside.
new_translation_vi: Geospider S4 ở Lahai-Roi bị thu hút bởi những nơi ngập tràn Lumiglow, nơi chúng thực hiện Lumiglow Revelation. Khi sự mặc khải hoàn tất, Lumiglow mờ dần, để lộ các vật thể ẩn bên trong.

source_en: In Lahai-Roi, Mining Reindeer can sense nearby Soliskin sealed inside special Luxites. The reindeer can fire a sustained laser beam to break the rock's outer shell, allowing you to free the trapped Soliskin.
new_translation_vi: Ở Lahai-Roi, Mining Reindeer có thể cảm nhận được Soliskin gần đó bị phong ấn bên trong các Luxite đặc biệt. Con tuần lộc có thể bắn một tia laser liên tục để phá vỡ lớp vỏ ngoài của đá, cho phép bạn giải phóng Soliskin

source_en: While riding on the Cruise Conduit, you can jump to adjacent Cruise Conduits. Use Jump while holding down directional buttons to jump off the conduit in the corresponding directions.
new_translation_vi: While riding on the Cruise Conduit, you can jump to adjacent Cruise Conduits. Use Jump while holding down directional buttons to jump off the conduit in the corresponding directions.

source_en: You earn Riding Points by Rail Gliding. Use Rail Drift to collect points on both sides of the rail. Use Bounce Jump to collect points in the air. Earn enough Riding Points to claim Shell Credits rewards.
new_translation_vi: You earn Riding Points by Rail Gliding. Use Rail Drift to collect points on both sides of the rail. Use Bounce Jump to collect points in the air. Earn enough Riding Points to claim Shell Credits rewards.

source_en: Domain is a new card category added to the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige. These cards possess extremely powerful abilities that can shift the tide of any duel.
new_translation_vi: Domain is a new card category added to the Lahai-Roi version of Peaks of Prestige. These cards possess extremely powerful abilities that can shift the tide of any duel.

source_en:
<color=#ffd12f>Cube Blocker</color> is the core component of the Smartprint Cube. It can be moved along the circuit as long as there is enough secure space along its path.
<color=#ffd12f>Cube Blockers</color> come in two forms, each with different secure space requirements to move.

source_en:
Some compilation processes will involve multiple Cube Blockers. All Cube Blockers must reach the corresponding Endpoint Module to complete compilation.
You can only control one Cube Blocker at a time. Use the <color=#ffd12f>Switch</color> button to change between Blockers.

[Look Customization]
Various customization modules can be applied to the expedition motorbike to change its appearance.

[Notes]
Each Vehicle Look item can only be purchased once and is used on the expedition motorbike.
Vehicle Looks can only be used after unlocking the motorbike in Chapter III Act I. However, they can still be purchased beforehand and will be usable after unlocking the permit.

source_en:

The new Startorch Racing Season is officially underway! Give it up for on-track thrills, roaring crowds, and enticing prizes! Hop on your beloved motorbike and sign up for the race now!

[Eligibility]

source_en:

- Cards have different Skills. Some Skills complement or boost other Skills. Please keep this in mind when building your deck.
